gb_param_ks: General parameters used for BLUE assimilation of Strickler Ks values.
cc_ks_act: Enable or disable  assimilation for the current Ks configuration.
label_ks_fld: Select the observation variable used: H (water elevation) or Q (discharge).
label_ks_seuil:
Misfit rejection threshold (%) for Ks assimilation.
Observations whose relative misfit (%) from the reference model exceeds this threshold are excluded from BLUE analysis.
label_ks_pert_min: Initial perturbation applied to minor-bed Ks values. Used to build the background covariance matrix B.
label_ks_pert_maj: Initial perturbation applied to major-bed Ks values. Used to build the background covariance structure for major-bed corrections.
label_ks_sigma: Number of loop cycles for repeating the BLUE operation with updates to matrices B and R.
bt_sel_zone: Select spatial control zones for Ks assimilation directly on the map.
bt_reload_ks: Reload the control zones from the project.
bt_edit_zone: Enable/disable edition mode for Ks parameters and Observations selection.
label_ks_obs: Observation configuration for assimilation (std deviations, min/max bounds).
gb_minor: Parameters controlling assimilation for minor-bed Ks.
label_minor_std: Standard deviation applied to minor-bed Ks corrections.
label_minor_inf: Minimum allowed minor-bed Ks value after BLUE correction.
label_minor_sup: Maximum allowed minor-bed Ks value after BLUE correction.
gb_major: Parameters controlling assimilation for major-bed Ks.
label_major_std: Standard deviation applied to major-bed Ks corrections.
